hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's DFT results section.

outputs.description: First‑layer Li adsorption energy per Li atom (eV) on three differently terminated Ti3C2 monolayers.

output_contract.notes: This is a compute‑driven reproduction task. The solving agent must run DFT relaxations and CI‑NEB calculations using Quantum ESPRESSO and the specified pseudopotentials. No experimental data is required; the results are compared to the paper‑reported values within a hidden tolerance.
